pointauc.step1: Open pointauc.com and sign in — keep the auction tab open

pointauc.tokenSafety: The token gives full access to your Pointauc; we only read the lots with it. It is stored encrypted on our server and never shown to viewers. To revoke it: "Disconnect Pointauc" here, or a new token in the Pointauc settings.
pointauc.connectFailed: Pointauc rejected the token. Check it and that the pointauc.com tab is open
pointauc.loadFailed: Pointauc did not answer. Open pointauc.com with your auction and press Refresh
pointauc.empty: No lots in the auction yet
pointauc.noRepeats: Watched and queued titles are not added twice
pointauc.autoSyncHint: Once a minute, while the pointauc.com tab is open. Movies TMDB knows for sure go straight to the queue, other lots to "To review".
pointauc.syncNoAnswer: Pointauc did not answer right now. Open pointauc.com with the auction — the sync will try again.
pointauc.syncElsewhere: It is on for "{{title}}" now — switching it on here moves it.
